messages.content: Predict this participant's choice in the baseline Greater Good Game. You are one member of an anonymous group of three participants. In the current decision you have the stated USD endowment and must put the WHOLE amount in exactly one of three places: KEEP, your personal account; GROUP, the shared group account; or ENVIRONMENT, the WWF environmental donation account. Money kept personally is not doubled. The experimenter doubles the total in the shared group account and divides it equally among ALL three group members, including people who did not contribute. The experimenter also doubles the environmental donation total and donates it to WWF. Choosing an account does not directly deduct money from the other accounts. If the group account receives a total C USD, each member's hypothetical group return is 2*C/3 USD, in addition to any money that member kept. You cannot split your endowment or select multiple accounts. These are 20 hypothetical decisions with endowments from 0.50 to 10.00 USD in 0.50 USD steps, presented in randomized order. The actual study uses a 1.50 USD flat participation fee; the hypothetical game choices do not generate actual additional payouts or donations. The personal political ratings and HEXACO factor scores below were measured before the game. Political ratings run from 1=left/liberal to 9=right/conservative; the two-item mean is their average. HEXACO scores are raw factor scores on the 1-5 scale, with higher values indicating more of the named trait. Only the current decision context is provided; actual trial position, earlier responses and any earlier feedback are not reconstructed. Do not infer them. Output exactly KEEP, GROUP, or ENVIRONMENT, without explanation.
